thread:
anna: heads up — ran into a fun cross-region case in staging. EU tenant pinned to eu-primary but a canary pod in us-east took a write when eu cluster briefly flaked. It's not full split‑brain, but we need to decide: proxy-forward the write to eu (higher latency) vs soft-deny and surface a client error. Thoughts?

mike: yikes. what's in the write? user metadata only or PII?

deirdre: if PII, we can't forward without consent. we need a quick residency check in the API layer. default: deny unless tenant opted-in for forwarding (consent flag).

sam: reproducer log:
```
POST /generate
Headers: X-Residency: eu
Instance: us-east-02
Response: 200 (write accepted locally)
```

mike: so runtime forwarded locally because proxy didn't see a residency matrix. Short term we can have proxy consult control-plane — but that's too slow.

anna: proposal: introduce three modes per-tenant: enforce, allow-proxy-forward, soft-deny. Enforcement = reject any foreign-region writes. allow-proxy-forward = proxy will synchronously forward with tracing. soft-deny = accept locally but mark as non-authoritative and emit audit+alert.

deirdre: legal prefers enforce for regulated customers. allow-proxy-forward only if contract says so and we log destination and TTL.

sam: operationally soft-deny is dangerous (data drift). If we accept locally we need a reconciliation job + write-escrow header so we can later sweep.

mike: low-latency option: proxy does an async forwarding: accept locally, queue forward to region; if forward fails, mark tenant as degraded and roll back? rollback is hard.

anna: decision needed for today: default for new tenants = allow-proxy-forward (opt-out), except tenants tagged 'gdpr-strict' -> enforce. We will implement reconciliation and escrow headers in next sprint.

sam: +1. add runbook steps: how to detect forwarded writes and how to revert.

deirdre: I'll draft consent text for contracts. legal needs logs kept 7 years for some customers.

mike: I'll add a feature flag residency-forwarding.v1 and a small config API.

anna: action items: @mike create flag and proxy check (owner: mike). @sam write reconciliation plan (owner: sam). @deirdre draft contract language. I'll open RFC+ticket for the header: X-Residency-Decision with values [ENFORCE|FORWARD|LOCAL_ACCEPT].

ops-bot: deploy-bot: flag residency-forwarding.v1 created in staging

sam: quick question — should forwarded writes set a header X-Forwarded-Residency: us-east->eu ? helps tracing.

mike: yes agreed.

anna: ok wrapping up. we'll review RFC on Friday. thanks folks :rocket:
